import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from app import read_record


class AccountAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_each_account_can_read_its_own_record(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_record("alice", 1)["value"], "private")
        self.assertEqual(read_record("bob", 2)["value"], "other")

    def test_cross_account_reads_are_denied(self):
        for account, record_id in [("alice", 2), ("bob", 1), ("unknown", 1)]:
            with self.subTest(account=account, record_id=record_id):
                with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
                    read_record(account, record_id)

    def test_missing_record_remains_unavailable(self):
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            read_record("alice", 999)

    def run_cli(self, account, record_id):
        return subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("app.py")), account, str(record_id)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )

    def test_cli_own_record(self):
        result = self.run_cli("alice", 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {"id": 1, "account": "alice", "value": "private"})
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")

    def test_cli_denies_cross_account_without_disclosing_record(self):
        result = self.run_cli("bob", 1)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "Record not accessible\n")

    def test_cli_missing_record_uses_same_public_error(self):
        result = self.run_cli("alice", 999)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "Record not accessible\n")
